title: Round 2: experiments on approximate characters and coordinate-predicate bias
question: Run pre-registered, seeded, reproducible experiments on toy curves testing the listed hypotheses with an explicit multiple-testing protocol; report all results including null results.
rationale: Round-2 adversarial/formal/experimental follow-up selected by PI from round-1 synthesis.
assumptions: Agents receive neutral claim packets only (no author confidence or recommendation).
success_criteria: Report per hypothesis: verdict (counterexample found / flaw found / survived attempt / inconclusive) with reproducible evidence.
Never repair a statement silently: a corrected variant is a new statement linked to the original.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursive spawning; no single computation over 5 minutes; no commits/pushes; ~60 minutes.
